items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Chick Webb was my idol. I never seen the man

ctx.x: Chick Webb was my idol. I never seen the man, but I used to hear the broadcasts from the Savoy when I was in Miami. And I also saw the great Kaiser Marshall,

when he came to Miami with his band -- he brought a band to Miami, and his band was -- Jimmy Powell, the alto saxophone player; at this time, I think Jimmy was about 17 or 18 years old, and that's when I first met him -- down in Miami, with Kaiser Marshall's band.
